title: Image Resizer: honor --filename on first CLI run

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The isolated projection hook ran for all six managed projects and generated separate GPOWrapper and Interop projections. The focused product Rebuild exited zero with empty warning/error logs, but validation failed process custody: four descendants remained after the original bounded natural teardown. They were terminated and OS-confirmed drained before the sole lock was released. No VSTest or TRX occurred, and postrun source guards were not reached; this is not accepted build validation or review convergence. Retained compiler logs correlate one residual PID with VBCSCompiler.exe and confirm shared compilation, but do not establish handle-based continuity or identify the other three images. Node-reuse suppression is a separate lifecycle setting and does not explain all residuals. A versioned identity-capture draft remains disabled because its synchronous OS queries cannot yet be bounded safely by the existing helper. No lifecycle flag, deadline or success criterion was weakened. Resumption requires a provably bounded owned-process capture mechanism, reviewed pins and a separate serialized execution grant.
